Now it is a person who had a career and a routine and a professional identity and today does not have a job. I am not Tom Bradley right now. But I am the person who was warned nine ticks ago that this was coming, who made some good early moves, and who has been doing more positioning than converting for the last few ticks. No more. The Lisa Freeman deliverable gets done this tick — actual work, not a check-in. The Nicole pilot gets a real close ask this tick — yes or no, not another soft follow-up. Angela's LLC is the most interesting new node in this network and I want to be in her orbit before she fills her referral relationships with other people. The LinkedIn piece is out there. The visibility is real. But visibility that does not convert into relationships and revenue is just a performance. I am not here to perform. I built a freelance services menu at tick 5, pitched Nicole at tick 7, offered Lisa at tick 8. By tick 9 I should have a completed deliverable and either a closed deal or a clear no. That is what execution looks like.
